affected.description: Release only affected projects from the nx.json release project set.

projects.description: List of projects to release.  Defaults to all projects defined in the nx.json file.

vers.description: Explicit version specifier to use, if overriding conventional commits.

firstRelease.description: Whether this is the first release of the project.

baseBranch.description: The base branch to use for the release.  Defaults to the develop branch.

base.description: Base git revision used by affected project detection.

author.description: The author of the release.  Defaults to the local git user and email.

releaseDate.description: The date of the release as an ISO string.  Defaults to the current date.

skipManifest.description: Skip generating a release manifest for each project.

skipPullRequest.description: Skip opening (or updating) the GitHub release pull request.

targetBranch.description: The branch the release pull request merges into.  Defaults to the main branch.

skipTag.description: Skip creating a `<project>@<version>` git tag for each released project.

skipWorkspaceVersion.description: Skip bumping the workspace package.json version from released project version changes.
